correctness.rationale: Reindex π1 to reduce random map to u+σ(u). For missing symbol y, forbidden permutation board is one perfect matching, giving derangement probability d_N. For two absent symbols y,z, their perfect matchings alternate along translation orbits of h=z−y; union decomposes into N/ord(h) bipartite cycles with 2ord(h) edges. The exact cycle matching rook polynomial A_m has coefficients (2m)/(2m−k) binomial(2m−k,k); inclusion-exclusion against (N−k)! yields Q_N(m). Indicator covariance yields the displayed variance formula. Independent exhaustive 24-permutation enumerations verify the distinct size laws and variances 7/12 vs 5/4 for Z4 and Z2²; finite checks support, not prove, general N.
residual_risks: Bounded computations are not proofs of all-parameter or asymptotic theorems.
